B21.name: 鳡鱼
B21.form: a large terminal mouth with the cleft reaching below the eye, a bony knob at the front of the lower jaw, small eyes, fine scales
B21.fins: pectoral fins not reaching the pelvic fins, pelvic fins not reaching the anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin
B21.colour: 体微黄，腹部银白色，背鳍、尾鳍青灰色，其余各鳍黄色

B22.name: 鲶鱼
B22.form: an elongated scaleless body, a large flattened head, a large mouth, small eyes, long barbels at the corners of the mouth
B22.fins: a long anal fin, a rounded tail fin

B23.name: 青鱼
B23.form: a cylindrical body, a slightly pointed broad flat head, a rounded belly with no ventral keel, the posterior part slightly laterally compressed
B23.colour: 体色青黑，背部较深，腹部较淡

B24.name: 刺鲃
B24.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, a conical head, an inferior mouth, two pairs of barbels, medium-sized scales, a complete lateral line
B24.fins: a dorsal fin with a stout spine
B24.colour: 体背青黑色，腹部灰白色

B25.name: 大口鲶
B25.form: a smooth scaleless body, a broad flattened head, a thick short trunk, a long flattened tail, skin rich in mucus, small eyes, a large mouth with the cleft reaching or passing below the middle of the eye, two pairs of barbels in adults and three pairs in juveniles
B25.fins: rough pectoral fins without a serrated notch, an anal fin continuous with the tail fin, a tail fin with the upper lobe longer than the lower

B26.name: 鳜鱼
B26.form: a deep laterally compressed body, a large mouth, the lower jaw protruding beyond the upper
B26.colour: 体黄绿色，体侧有不规则暗棕色斑块，腹部灰白

B27.name: 大眼鳜
B27.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, the chest and belly outlines curved, round scales, the head and back outlines raised, a large terminal slightly oblique mouth, small scales on the gill cover
B27.markings: an oblique band crossing the eye on each side of the head, a band from the top of the head to the front of the dorsal fin, irregular spots and stripes all over the flanks, four saddle-shaped blotches along the base of the dorsal fin, rows of spots on the dorsal and tail fins
B27.colour: 体侧棕黄色、灰黄或灰白，腹部灰白色，斑点和条纹呈棕褐色

B28.name: 长吻鮠
B28.form: a spindle-shaped body, a rounded belly, a laterally compressed tail, smooth scaleless skin, a straight lateral line, well-developed mucus glands
B28.fins: a dorsal fin with two spines and 6 to 7 rays, an anal fin with 14 to 18 rays, pectoral fins with one spine and 9 rays, pelvic fins with 6 rays

B29.name: 中华倒刺鲃
B29.form: an elongated laterally compressed body, the back elevated in a curve, a conical head, eyes set on the sides and widely spaced, a subinferior mouth, a blunt snout protruding slightly forward, two pairs of barbels, larger scales, a complete lateral line
B29.colour: 身体背部青黑色，腹部灰白色

B30.name: 胭脂鱼
B30.form: a laterally compressed deep body, the back particularly elevated at the origin of the dorsal fin, a small head, a rounded blunt snout
B30.markings: three forward-slanting transverse bands in juveniles, a single longitudinal band in adults
B30.colour: 幼鱼体色淡灰褐色并有3条黑色横带；成鱼雄鱼粉红色并有1条胭脂红色纵带，雌鱼暗红色纵带呈紫红色
